  • Method Details

    • capture

      public static CompressorTripResponse capture(String compressorTag, AntiSurge antiSurge, boolean tripObserved, Double tripResponseTimeSeconds, double allowableResponseTimeSeconds, String evidenceReference)
      Captures the anti-surge state and the independently observed trip response.
      Parameters:
      compressorTag - controlled compressor tag
      antiSurge - compressor anti-surge model after scenario execution
      tripObserved - whether the compressor trip was observed
      tripResponseTimeSeconds - observed time from trip demand to trip, or null when not observed
      allowableResponseTimeSeconds - maximum response time from the controlled requirement
      evidenceReference - controlled trip-logic or test evidence reference
      Returns:
      immutable response snapshot
